audit_reference: 10.6A Five-Country Canonical Coverage Audit Correction v1
note: Work packages are planning artifacts for a FUTURE 10.7 execution. This audit is read-only; no package is executed here. Priorities revised by 10.6A: P0 = observability + lineage + origin verification; P1 = ingestion framework + taxonomies first; P2 = country integrations; P3 = metrics/enrichment; P4 = optional backlog.
first_execution_recommendation: Start with 'Common Source Ingestion Framework v1 + AU CRICOS Source Manifest and Candidate Pipeline' (WP-01 + WP-02 + AU slice of WP-06), OR split as 10.7A Canonical Read-Only Observability -> 10.7B Common Ingestion Framework -> 10.7C AU CRICOS Candidate Pipeline. Output: manifest, snapshot checksum, parser, normalized institution/programme candidates, conflict register, validation report, dry-run import plan. NO production import.

packages.title: Canonical read-only audit observability
packages.description: Establish admin-only read-only access to canonical schemas for audit counts WITHOUT exposing them: psql read-only connection, or Supabase SQL editor SELECT-only, or admin-only audit script; transaction READ ONLY; schema-qualified counts; save audit result files. Do NOT recommend PostgREST exposure, public SELECT grant, anon/authenticated grant, browser access, or select-* public views.
packages.acceptance: Canonical schemas stay private; admin-only read-only row counts collectible; no new browser/PostgREST exposure; no privilege expansion.

packages.title: Common Source Ingestion Framework v1
packages.description: Build the shared ingestion framework used by all country integrations: fetch, checksum, snapshot manifest, parse, normalize, validate, dedupe, candidate JSONL, conflict register, validation report, dry-run import plan. No production import.
packages.acceptance: Framework produces manifest + snapshot checksum + parser + normalized institution/programme candidates + conflict register + validation report + dry-run import plan; no production write.

packages.title: Five-country source lineage and snapshot policy
packages.description: 3-tier raw data policy. Tier A (Git): manifest, metadata, download URL, retrieved_at, checksum, file size, licence, parser version, schema version, sample fixture, validation report. Tier B (object storage/controlled artifacts): large raw CSV/XLSX/ZIP/JSON-bulk/HTML/PDF snapshots. Tier C (no storage, re-download only): no-redistribution licences, authenticated/temporary URLs, ToS-restricted sources - Git still gets manifest + retrieval instructions + checksums. Recommended layout: data/source-manifests/{country}/{source}/.
packages.acceptance: Reproducible source lineage for AU/GB/US/CA/IE from manifests and checksums. Success is NOT defined as existence of a data/raw/{country} folder.

packages.title: Taxonomy ingestion: US BLS SOC 2020 + IE CSO
packages.description: Ingest US BLS SOC 2020 (+OEWS) and IE CSO occupation codes into taxonomy.occupations; taxonomy FIRST before country programme integrations. Verified via WP-01 read-only counts.
packages.acceptance: occupations_us and occupations_ie present with read-only-verified counts.

packages.title: Origin-comparison runtime verification
packages.description: Determination already made by 10.6A: migration 20260712121724 NOT applied (PGRST205 for all its tables) and runtime degrades gracefully (verified). Verify at runtime before 10.7 ingestion; decide apply-migration, backfill, or de-scope with recorded decision.
packages.acceptance: attachOriginComparisons returns non-degraded data OR feature de-scoped with decision recorded.

packages.title: Country institution/programme integrations
packages.description: Ingest canonical institution/programme data per country: AU CRICOS -> US College Scorecard -> IE Qualifax -> GB OfS -> CA IRCC DLI. Execution order adjustable by automation difficulty and licence. Includes GB/UK naming canonicalization (uk-* -> gb-*) with country-normalization alias kept for backward compat.
packages.acceptance: Country institution/programme candidate pipelines run through WP-02 framework with lineage (WP-03) and read-only verified counts (WP-01); no unverified production import.

packages.title: Metrics and enrichment
packages.description: Occupation metrics, regional metrics, programme-to-occupation links, shortage/projection enrichment (GOV.UK shortage list, BLS employment projections, CSO). Includes orphan/duplicate cleanup of empty placeholder fixtures.
packages.acceptance: Metric rows present with source_register_records lineage; no empty placeholder fixtures.

packages.title: AU Nursing optional enrichment backlog
packages.description: DEFERRED optional enrichment for AU nursing canonical candidates: professionalOutcome, accreditation detail, mandatoryStudyCosts, estimatedTotalTuition, registration eligibility. Program Compare v1 already covers institution/programme/qualification/campus/city/duration/tuition/source/reviewed date/null handling - this package does not block it.
packages.acceptance: Candidate package reaches A_READY with enrichment fields; UI fixture linked to canonical.
